text.en: A majority of clients commend Jeff and Jalen for professional, patient, and knowledgeable coaching during private lessons and board-and-train programs, noting clear instructions that empower owners. In contrast, critical reviews express sharp dissatisfaction, citing an unaddressed consultation and an allegation of extreme negligence regarding pet care.

title.en: Strong obedience gains with mixed feedback

text.en: Several pet parents praise dramatic transformations in their dogs, describing successful loose leash walking, resolved reactivity, and reliable obedience following board-and-train programs. However, feedback is divided, as two dissatisfied reviewers reported that specific behavioral problems were left unresolved despite paying for consultation time.

Most reviewers describe attentive handling, noting that trainers spent significant time with their dogs and genuinely cared about helping pets overcome behavioral obstacles. Conversely, a severe one-star complaint alleged critical negligence resulting in a dog's death while under the facility's care, representing a sharp divide in customer experiences.

q.en: What training programs do clients describe?

a.en: Reviewers describe board-and-train programs, in-home consultations, and one-on-one handler coaching sessions.

q.en: Do trainers work with adult or older dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients mention successful obedience coaching and habit correction for older dogs, including senior retrievers.

q.en: Are there negative reviews regarding care?

a.en: Yes, two critical reviews cite unaddressed behavioral concerns during consultations and an allegation of negligence.

q.en: Do owners receive guidance on maintaining training?

a.en: Yes, positive reviews note that trainers provide follow-up sessions and homework to help owners sustain progress.
